decisions.summary: Changed questions from the feature's non-merge commits whose SUBJECT line opens Feature NNN / NNN:, filtered in Python; findings pages only; the pre-329 prefix accepted
decisions.why: FR-001's attribution rule and the spec's merge rule as written; changed_questions() reads %s only and test_only_the_subject_line_names_the_feature pins it. The regex also takes 'NNN ' with a space, which still opens with the number.

decisions.summary: A claim cites a question only through a pointer to its FINDINGS page; a drawing-page-only question reads 'no claim cites it'; checked = not in claims.owed() for any reason
decisions.why: Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE item resolved. CITED is end-anchored on NNNN-<id>.html and claim pointers are POINTER.fullmatch'd file paths with no anchor, so .drawing/.notes never match and a findings pointer always does. Every counted claim is now fingerprinted on the findings page, so a rewrite re-owes it (FR-001(a)); this owes more, not less, and matches the spec's edge case that only the findings page is owed.
